## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Cycle confirmations: Consumer Cycle ↑ rising and SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND show cyclical leadership, while HYG/LQD: CREDIT STRESS ↓ falling signals risk friction — mixed risk, money rotating not fleeing.  

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -5.74% | 1M: -13.93%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit tension: HYG/LQD: CREDIT STRESS ↓ falling despite HYG (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.36%) RECOVERY. Stocks vs bonds in CORRECTION: SPY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY.  

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-positive financial conditions: Dollar Strength (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND → flat; Yield curve ↑ rising in RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY — conditions supportive but watch credit spread action.  

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech and semis leading: XLK (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND; Momentum ETFs MTUM (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND confirm. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%) CORRECTION — style: Growth/Momentum leading.  

**5. US vs Global?**  
US and EM strength this week: SPY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +7.31%) ABOVE TREND; China weakness persists: FXI (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND.  

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation intact but mixed: IWM (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +0.95%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on flows, while IBIT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND signals crypto fatigue.  

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Reflation tone: CPER (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND and Copper/Gold ↑ rising; Gold soft: GLD (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -4.44%) BELOW TREND.  

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy under pressure and divergent: XLE (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -7.89% | 1M: +0.97%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -5.46% | 1M: +5.82%) CORRECTION — watch for continued volatility in commodities.  

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND show clear sector leadership; DIVERGENCE (minor) across TLT, XLE and several commodities where 1W ≠ 1M (TLT RECOVERY, XLE CORRECTION, UNG CORRECTION) — monitor momentum cohesion.  

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor growth/momentum exposures: XLK (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND and selective small caps IWM (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging energy XLE (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND, and monitor HYG/LQD for credit inflection.  

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -4.51% | 1M: +1.72%) CORRECTION, FXI (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -4.44%) BELOW TREND.  

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: BNO (1W: -7.89% | 1M: +0.97%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -5.46% | 1M: +5.82%) CORRECTION, PALL and silver metrics showing weakness.  

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX (1W: -5.74% | 1M: -13.93%) BELOW TREND near complacency zone ~20; SPY/TLT at ~8.82 (Stocks vs Bonds) in CORRECTION — watch for a sustained break; HYG/LQD: CREDIT STRESS ↓ falling — watch for stabilization as a risk pivot; Tech vs Financials level 3.57 (Tech leadership) to signal style persistence.  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Tech/semis and small caps showing strength: XLK (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +15.55%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +14.97% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk to monitor: HYG/LQD: CREDIT STRESS ↓ falling (credit strain) alongside energy and China weakness — monitor these divergences for a potential rotation or risk repricing.
